direct_answer: [Saved Reference Analysis] Inspect samples [300..600] (10.00s–20.00s video time) first. Episode 'rollout_T1001_1014_213934' is a policy_rollout where action.* represents 'issued_robot_command' (policy_output_After_chunk_blending_clipped_to_motor_limits), NOT a human leader arm command. In this interval, state.wrist_flex moves from -84.09 deg to 62.11 deg (min -84.35 deg, max 62.64 deg) with state-minus-action mean_signed_diff=-1.32 deg (max_abs_diff=11.32 deg at sample 423); state.gripper transitions from 35.91 to 0.94 (range 0.94..53.79) with state-minus-action mean_signed_diff=+3.40 and max_abs_diff=24.27 at sample 318 (10.60s video time).
